admission.justification: dashboard/src/cockpit/Cockpit.tsx keeps the role pane mounted, PaseoChatFrame.tsx retains the iframe, and paseoFrameControl.ts steers ready-channel changes, preventing view switches and result reads from discarding the in-progress native chat document and interaction state. The launcher-owned navigation toggle this justification used to name is removed by rule 7 and is no longer part of the claim.

applicability: Normal dashboard view switches, result reads and ready-channel execution changes while the embedded control channel is ready.
conditions: The pane remains under the existing hidden persistent ViewLayer.
The frame descriptor and frame generation remain unchanged.
exclusions: Explicit Retry and the existing documented 10-second unavailable-control URL path may create a new frame generation.
The dashboard's removed sidebar and its launcher button are not navigation of this obligation (rules 7 to 10); the host's list and the frame's ready channel are.
Preserved DOM identity does not certify every native application state or unrelated session/PTY path.
